meta.defaultDescription: New York-style gourmet cookies, signature drinks and cacao at an intimate cookie shop in Condesa. Monthly rotating menu, events and pickup at Nuevo León 217.

home.heroSubtitle: A cookie shop hidden inside Pabellón Nuevo León. Gourmet cookies baked in short batches, signature drinks, and a menu that changes every month.
home.introTitle: This isn't just a cookie shop.
home.introBody: At d-stellar we bake in short batches, serve cacao and coffee with intention, and open our doors at night for screenings, viewing parties, and gatherings that build community. It's a small place that feels huge once you're inside.
home.statementBody: A brand that's transgressive, unstoppable and kind — where you can express yourself freely, with no fear of judgment. A community. A universe of your own.
home.menuTeaserBody: Five cookies, signature drinks, and everything else — it changes every month, so if you loved something, come back soon.
home.eventsTeaserBody: Viewing parties, collaborations, and private nights in a limited-capacity space.
home.visitTeaserBody: Inside Pabellón Nuevo León, a short walk from Parque México.

visit.title: Find us inside Pabellón Nuevo León
visit.intro: d-stellar is at Av. Nuevo León 217, inside Pabellón Nuevo León, right in the heart of Hipódromo Condesa. The entrance is hidden — here's how to find it.

steps.title: 1. Nuevo León 217
steps.body: Look for the "Pabellón Nuevo León" sign on the avenue, between storefronts and apartment buildings.

steps.title: 2. Walk into the passage
steps.body: The pavilion is a shared indoor passage — walk in and head toward the back, past the other shops.

steps.title: 3. Look for the d-stellar door
steps.body: The "d-stellar" sign hangs over a narrow doorway next to the community flag — that's it.

hoursBody: Monday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday: 11:00 am – 7:00 pm.

gettingHere.title: On foot

gettingHere.title: By car
gettingHere.body: Paid street parking on Nuevo León and nearby streets. Looking for a spot? Drop this address into your GPS and it'll take you to the parallel street to park.

privateEvents.title: Your own universe, for a night
privateEvents.intro: Birthdays, private screenings, brand activations, collaborations — d-stellar can be booked out for small groups looking for something different.
privateEvents.pitchBody: We don't have a banquet hall. We have an intimate space in Condesa, full of personality, so you get your own screening, your own party, your own universe — with nobody else in it that night.
useCases: LGBTQ+ events and drag viewing parties

about.title: The Sweet Universe Company
about.lead: d-stellar started in 2024, founded by Hernán Castilla and Eduardo Hernández, on one simple idea: cookies can be the excuse to build community.
body: We started baking in short batches for a handful of Condesa neighbors. We're still doing exactly that — we just fit exactly right now, and that feels perfect.
Every month we reinvent the cookie and drinks collection. Every so often, we dim the lights for a screening, a collaboration, or a small party that feels enormous.
about.brandStatement: We're a brand that's transgressive, unstoppable and kind — where you can express yourself freely, with no fear of judgment. A community. A universe of your own.
about.quote: Together we shine brighter — it's not just a tagline, it's why we open the door every morning.
